# Research report 1 of 2

I've confirmed the key primary source and am now writing up the findings, leaving out anything dated after 2026-09-27.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names no URL. In practice two things decide it: Anthropic's model announcements (anthropic.com/news, docs model list) and the model picker in the Claude web app (claude.ai).
- Structure: the question resolves YES if, before Oct 17, **no** Haiku newer than 4.5 is released, **or** Haiku disappears from the web app. So NO requires both a new Haiku release before Oct 17 and Haiku still showing in the web app. One ambiguity: if a new Haiku replaces 4.5 in the picker, a strict reading of "Haiku doesn't appear" might not apply, because some Haiku would still be visible.
- 2026-09-22: Anthropic's official Opus 5.5 post says "Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5" are coming "in the coming weeks" and will bring many of the same performance, efficiency and safety improvements. It gives no specific date. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5-5)

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-09-27)
- Haiku 4.5 is still the newest Haiku. Haiku 5.5 has been announced but not released, and I found no release date.
- I found nothing on or before 2026-09-27 saying Haiku has been removed from the Claude web app.
- Nothing settles the question yet. The key uncertainty is whether Haiku 5.5 ships before Oct 17, roughly 3.5 weeks after the Sep 22 "coming weeks" statement.
- The Claude 5 generation (Opus 5, Sonnet 5) shipped without a Haiku, so the line goes from Haiku 4.5 straight to the announced 5.5. X posts had predicted a Haiku 5 for August or September, and that did not happen. This comes from secondary trackers I could not fully date-check. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_(AI)), [timeline](https://github.com/jqueryscript/anthropic-claude-timeline)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-23: Taiwanese coverage of the Opus 5.5 launch (the page didn't load, so this rests on search snippets) reports that Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 have not launched and will arrive "in the coming weeks". [technews.tw](https://technews.tw/2026/09/23/anthropic-upgrades-claude-with-new-opus-5-5-model/)
- 2026-09-22: Opus 5.5 is released as the first Claude 5.5 model. It reportedly costs about 40% less than Opus 5 ($4/$20 per million tokens) and roughly matches "Claude Fable 5.1" on most tasks. So the "Fable" premium tier mentioned in the question's context is real. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5-5), [gori.me](https://gori.me/?p=170548), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/claude-opus-5-5-is-here-7-things-developers-should-know-before-using-it-80ede01fc1d4)
- Before 2026-09-22: digg items describe Opus 5.5 "in stealth testing". [digg](https://digg.com/ai/2i38tn81)
- I could not find an Anthropic statement on or before 2026-09-27 about deprecating Haiku in the consumer app.

## 4. Base rates
- Past Haiku releases: Claude 3 Haiku (Mar 2024), Claude 3.5 Haiku (Oct 2024, about 4 months after 3.5 Sonnet), Haiku 4.5 (2025-10-15, about 2 weeks after Sonnet 4.5 on 2025-09-29, and about 5 months after Sonnet 4). [Anthropic timeline tracker](https://hidekazu-konishi.com/entry/anthropic_claude_model_release_timeline.html), [technews.tw Haiku 4.5](https://technews.tw/2025/10/17/anthropic-introducing-claude-haiku-4-5/)
- How fast Anthropic delivers on "coming weeks": in Oct 2024, 3.5 Haiku was announced alongside the new 3.5 Sonnet as coming "later this month" and shipped about 2 weeks later (early Nov 2024 in the API). Haiku releases have sometimes slipped past the stated timing.
- Historically, Haiku has followed the lead model by anywhere from 2 weeks to 5 months. Here the gap to Oct 17 would be 25 days after the Opus 5.5 announcement.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has a related market, "Will a new Claude Haiku model be released...", by dbohdan. The page would not load through the proxy, so I could not get its price or exact criteria. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/dbohdan/will-a-new-claude-haiku-model-be-re)
- I found no Polymarket or Kalshi market on a Haiku release date.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Sonnet 5.5 is expected first, since Anthropic listed it before Haiku 5.5. If Sonnet 5.5 ships soon, a Haiku 5.5 release before Oct 17 becomes more plausible.
- Haiku 5.5 itself is promised "in the coming weeks" from 2026-09-22, with no date. Watch anthropic.com/news, the @claudeai X account, and the API model docs.
- Anthropic could also announce changes to the claude.ai model selector, such as removing Haiku 4.5 or swapping in 5.5. That would bear on the second YES condition and on how "Haiku doesn't appear" is read.
- Resolution date is about 2026-10-08, but the criteria cutoff is "before October 17". A release between Oct 8 and Oct 16 may be relevant depending on when the question is actually resolved.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I only used information published on or before 2026-09-27. Several pages I found describe events after that date, and I left them out.

**Bottom line:** On 2026-09-27, Haiku 4.5 was still the newest Haiku. But on 2026-09-22 Anthropic said publicly that Haiku 5.5 would arrive "in the coming weeks." Because the criteria use OR, the question resolves NO only if a newer Haiku is released before October 17 and Haiku also stays on the Claude web app.

## 1. Resolution source
- No URL is given. The deciding facts are (a) whether Anthropic officially releases a Haiku newer than 4.5 before Oct 17, and (b) whether any Haiku stays in the claude.ai model picker.
- The best primary sources are Anthropic's news page and its model deprecations page. The deprecations page lists `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` as Active, retirement "not sooner than October 15, 2026." That is only a floor. As of 2026-09-27 it is not a scheduled retirement, and Haiku 4.5 had not been formally deprecated. [Anthropic deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-09-27: No Haiku newer than Haiku 4.5 had been released. Nothing has settled the question yet.
- 2026-09-22: The Opus 5.5 announcement says "Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5" will arrive "in the coming weeks," with no specific date. This directly contradicts the premise that "Haiku is going to be deprecated." [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5-5)
- I found no evidence from before Sept 27 that Haiku had been removed from the Claude web app model picker.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-22: Anthropic launched Opus 5.5 and confirmed Haiku 5.5 is coming "in the coming weeks." [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5-5)
- September 2026: Leaks claimed Haiku 5.5 was finished and might beat Opus, but Anthropic only confirmed that it is coming. One aggregator says a September leak claimed the 5.5 generation would drop Haiku, and the official announcement contradicts that. [pasqualepillitteri.it](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/fr/news/17763/leak-claude-haiku-5-5-depasse-opus), [Emergent](https://emergent.sh/news/claude-haiku-5-5-release-date)
- 2026-09-08 and 2026-08-22: Posts on X predicted a "Haiku 5" for "next week." Neither prediction came true. [cellcog](https://cellcog.ai/blog/claude-haiku-5-5-release-date/)
- 2026 (Claude 5 generation): Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 shipped with no Haiku 5, which is part of why people expected Haiku to be dropped. [Emergent](https://emergent.sh/news/claude-haiku-5-5-release-date)
- 2026-04-20: Haiku 3 was retired. 2026-02-19: Haiku 3.5 was retired. Both were replaced by Haiku 4.5, which shows Anthropic has kept a Haiku tier going. [Anthropic deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations)
- 2026-09-03: Heroku (a third party) ended support for Claude 3 Haiku and pointed users to Haiku 4.5. [Heroku](https://devcenter.heroku.com/changelog-items/3711)

## 4. Base rates
- Haiku release history: Haiku 3 (March 2024), Haiku 3.5 (late 2024), Haiku 4.5 (October 2025). That is roughly one Haiku a year, released after the matching Sonnet and Opus. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_(AI))
- The Claude 5 generation broke that pattern by shipping without a Haiku.
- Anthropic's "coming weeks" promises have often been kept within about 1 to 6 weeks, but I found no systematic data on this. The window from Sept 22 to Oct 17 is about 3.5 weeks.
- Anthropic gives at least 60 days' notice before retiring an API model. No Haiku 4.5 deprecation notice existed as of Sept 27, so an API retirement before Oct 17 was effectively impossible. Removal from the consumer app is a separate decision and doesn't require that notice. [Anthropic deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has this market ("claude haiku dying in 3 months," by Laplace), but the page wouldn't load (proxy refused), so I couldn't get its probability. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Laplace/claude-haiku-dying-in-3-months)
- There is a related Manifold market on Anthropic deprecation announcements. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-anthropic-announce-the-depreca)
- I found no Polymarket or Kalshi market on a Haiku release.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Release of Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, both promised for "the coming weeks" after Sept 22. The question turns mainly on whether Haiku 5.5 ships before Oct 17.
- Oct 15, 2026: the earliest possible retirement date for Haiku 4.5 on Anthropic's API. Separately, Amazon Bedrock lists Oct 15, 2026 as a scheduled deprecation date for one Haiku 4.5 build. [futureagi](https://futureagi.com/llm-cost-calculator/bedrock/eu-anthropic-claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1-0)
- Possible changes to the claude.ai model picker if a new Haiku replaces 4.5 or Haiku is removed.
- The criteria are ambiguous: it's unclear whether a release that is API-only, or not in the app, counts as "released."
